title: Crispy Hwajeon with Semolina Crunch
description: A Korean-inspired dessert that combines the crunch of semolina with the delicate flavor of hwajeon. Perfect for snacking or as a dessert.
instructions: In a bowl, mix together semolina, granulated sugar, and crushed sesame seeds.
Add coconut oil and corn syrup to the bowl and mix until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Crush the hwajeon into small pieces and add them to the bowl. Mix well.
Transfer the mixture to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 15-20 minutes or until the mixture is golden brown and crispy.
Remove from the oven and let cool completely.
Break the mixture into pieces and serve as a crunchy dessert.
